generated_by: modes_calc.py v3 (frame zip-tied to deck + gap, dance excitation; v2 photo geometry)

fixed.description: post bottom bolted/screwed to the deck or to a base plate screwed to the deck
fixed.governing: whole-cart transverse tip (5.38 m/s2); post yield at 23.9 m/s2 is not governing

pinned_gap.description: post bottom captive (socket/hole/base plate with play) but free to rotate through a gap; shell + velcro take the moment after the gap closes
pinned_gap.governing: velcro/cradle tip accel divided by impact factor 2.0 (gap closure); the shell wall at the slot can also crush (hollow shell, local load ~m a h / R)

velcro_only.description: post bottom reaches nothing (sketch 'gap'); bear+post hang on the shell via the slot and feet velcro; shell held by bottom velcro on the cradle
velcro_only.governing: rigid stack about the cradle contact edge b=0.12 m, h_cm=0.66 m; velcro peel would raise it to 2.45 m/s2 but velcro fatigues under 2 Hz cyclic peel -> no credit; feet-velcro peel lets the bear+post fall THROUGH the gap

frame_ziptied_gap.description: v3 PRIMARY (Tony): post is part of the tubular stand frame sitting on the deck, zip-tied (3-4 x 4.8 mm/50 lb ties), ~1 mm gap
frame_ziptied_gap.governing: LIFT-OFF / rocking onset about the frame rail (g b/h, b=0.22 m, h=0.66 m); true toppling needs tie failure at 30 m/s2 or whole-cart tip at 5.3 m/s2 -> ties are NOT the strength weak link (0 N per tie at the real jerk, 17 N at cart-tip accel vs 222 N rating); the weak link is slack/creep + the 1 mm gap = rocking impacts

sketch_angles.mode_shape: alternating-sign 3-link = highest chain mode ~ 3rd bending mode of a beam (2 interior nodes); low net CoM shift, high hinge forces

plausible_top_8cm.mode_shape: alternating-sign 3-link = highest chain mode ~ 3rd bending mode of a beam (2 interior nodes); low net CoM shift, high hinge forces

dance_internal_excitation.note: shell sways on the fixed post: reaction force at ~1 m -> moment vs gravity restoring m g b = 23.7 N m -> no lift-off from the dance alone, but 2 slot impacts per sway and it sits in the sway band

modes.name: bear_on_post_sway_FIXED_base

modes.name: bear_on_frame_sway_ZIPTIED_gap
modes.basis: v3 PRIMARY: post+frame flex (x0.4-0.8 of the bare-post cantilever: crossbar torsion, 'wobbling the pole wobbles the whole frame') in series with frame rocking on 1-3 zip ties per rail (k 5-100 kN/m each, lever 2b=0.44 m). Inside the 1 mm gap (theta < 2.3 mrad, head < 4 mm) the tie stiffness is ZERO -> rocking impacts on the deck

modes.name: frame_rocking_on_zip_ties

modes.name: shell_dance_slip_on_post

modes.name: bear_on_post_sway_PINNED_gap

Amplitude-dependent: inside the gap the stiffness is ZERO and the post hits the slot edge (impact). PHOTO v2 + sketch 'gap'

modes.name: stack_rocking_VELCRO_only
